PluginData.Author: Space; Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Night vision with active and through-glass passive modes.
PluginData.Description:
Night vision inspired by Elite Dangerous. Active mode brightens dark scenes, outlines nearby geometry, and uses a short-range infrared fallback. Passive mode limits the effect to one-way glass.
Hold the light key (L by default) to toggle it. A short press still toggles the light. Helmet, camera, and spectator modes can be changed in the plugin settings.
This is a local visual effect and does not change gameplay.
For support please join the Pulsar Discord: https://discord.gg/z8ZczP2YZY
